title: Forty Hadith: An Exposition
author: Sayyid Ruhullah Musawi Khomeini
translators: Mahliqa Qara’i and Ali Quli Qara’i
description: Detailed commentary on 40 selected traditions narrated through the Prophet (S) and his Ahl al-Bayt (a) on topics of ethics and spirituality, including jihad al-nafs.
Islamic scholars, motivated by a tradition from the Prophet Muhammad which promises Divine rewards for scholars who collect forty traditions, compile hadith narrations in groups of forty.
